summary: VRSN, MSM and AAPL lead: all three score fscore 9 of 9 computable with operating cash flow above net income, and VRSN also sits at the 99th percentile of in-sector gross profitability. Lesson L3 shaped the call: several sector ranks rest on SIC labels that misdescribe the business (DPZ, FAST, MSM, MSCI, MCO, CART, AYI), so I leaned on absolute quality and cash conversion rather than the sector percentile. Held names DPZ, CARG and IDXX are fundamentally sound but each has a live non-fundamental issue (stale stop, 11-05 print, post-gap price); the holdings off the menu are all funds or crypto with no SEC statements to screen.
